name: The Well of Eternity
shortDescription: The immense arcane lake formed when the keepers stabilized the wound left by Y'Shaarj's removal.
body: The Well was Azeroth's exposed lifeblood brought into balance by wards. It nourished life, empowered kaldorei civilization, became the gateway contested during the War of the Ancients, and collapsed in the catastrophe remembered as the Great Sundering.
